scraped.author: Tyler Durden
scraped.h1: Is "Epstein Didn't Kill Himself" Going Mainstream?
scraped.body_text:
Authored by Kit Knightly via OffGuardian ,

When it comes to anti-establishment catchphrases, "Epstein Didn't Kill Himself" is probably second only to "Jet Fuel Doesn't Melt Steel Beams" in terms of pop culture footprint.

The two phrases are twinned in that way, punchlines removed from the jokes. Words memed into quasi-meaninglessness by over repetition.

But the Epstein line appears - suddenly - to be doing something jet fuel never could - getting serious mainstream consideration and air time.

Forensic pathologist Dr Michael Freeman has come forward asserting he disagrees with the official autopsy findings of suicide , and that his interpretation is that evidence points far more directly at homicide.

Dr Freeman is editor-in-chief of the Journal of Forensic and Legal Medicine and, according to CBS, was granted access to the confidential medical and police files by Jeffrey Epstein's brother.

Amazingly, his revelations have been covered by pretty much every major network...

On the 16th he was on the BBC's Newsnight:

"So you are saying that Epstein was killed by another person?" Michael Freeman, a prominent expert in forensic medicine, speaks to #Newsnight about his claims that Jeffrey Epstein's death was a "result of a homicide". Warning: Distressing details of death and injury and... pic.twitter.com/7xqUFf8YRA

— BBC Newsnight (@BBCNewsnight) November 16, 2026

Note the BBC tells us Freeman is a "prominent expert", NOT a "crazy conspiracy theorist" .

Interesting, no?

And again, in the BBC's main write up he's presented as a "forensic expert",

We're being telegraphed that Freeman is a person we ought to listen to.

CBS , the New York Post , the New York Times and Channel 4 in the UK have all run with the same line on this story, and only CNN have put even a hint of reservation in their headline :

Forensic expert says Epstein was likely killed, but NYC medical examiner stands by suicide ruling

Prominent author and podcaster Sam Harris released a video three days ago titled "Why I'm Reconsidering Jeffrey Epstein's Death" .

TMZ have gone with it in their uniquely TMZ-ish style :

JEFFREY EPSTEIN'S DEATH FORENSIC EXPERTS REVEAL NEW THEORY...This Was No Suicide!!!

Three exclamation points. Classy stuff.

So - why exactly is this happening?

I trust we are all sufficiently awake and aware that we can immediately rule out any fanciful notions these outlets are saying this stuff "because it's true" .

I mean, that Epstein didn't kill himself almost certainly IS true - one way or another - but it was just as true 7 long years ago when these outfits were all insisting he simply offed himself .

These state sponsored propaganda machines don't say things because they're true.

They don't care or even acquaint themselves with what's true. It's not their brief.

And that doesn't change because something is obviously super duper true.

It simply does not matter how true a thing is - the propaganda machine will simply ignore it, step over it, walk right past it .

If it isn't briefed to talk about something, it won't . Even if it happens to be the biggest most blatant truth in the universe.

I mean, just look around you. Whistleblowers, experts and journalists have been questioning the "official versions" of newsworthy deaths from JFK to George Floyd and producing solid evidence for doing so - but if those questions don't serve an agenda they generally don't get on the news .

And they certainly don't get on the news without the usual eye-rolling "this guy's a crazy conspiracy theorist, here's an article about how anyone who agrees with him is ugly and has no friends" rider.

So, don't fall for the lame "oh FINALLY the mainstream are seeing the light" line.

No. They haven't. They won't. They can't. They are just using a little bit of potential truth to sell you another mountain of lies and distortion.

Oh, and Speaking of George Floyd...

A leading pathologist says there was "zero per cent chance" that convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein died by suicide. Professor Michael Freeman is a cause of death specialist, who was an expert witness in the George Floyd case. After reviewing the New York medical examiner's... pic.twitter.com/5XlJnoU6Gw

— Channel 4 News (@Channel4News) November 17, 2026

It just so happens Dr Freeman was an "expert witness" in the George Floyd case, who testified to its being a homicide .

And again, note he's presented to us as an "expert witness" a "leading pathologist" and a "cause of death specialist", he is NOT tagged as a "rogue pathologist", "conspiracy theorist" or "controversial figure".

So what do we have here?

We have a "leading pathologist", with a history of making politically convenient statements that serve the agenda (eg. George Floyd), suddenly "revealing" that Epstein didn't kill himself, and being given a platform to do so in a lot of mainstream media.

If you're not up to speed yet - what you're looking at here is narrative creation to serve an agenda.

What will the narrative/agenda turn out to be?

Is there going to be a witch hunt to "identify" Epstein's likely "murderer(s)"? Will there be lurid allegations and crazy assumptions circulating about all the usual hate figures?

Let's wait to see.

It should also be noted this bullhorned "revelation" is accompanied by a few other Epstein-adjacent stories .

Earlier this month, the US House Oversight Committee published their 137-page report on the "mishandling" of the Epstein case . The New York Times published a video about what comes next in that process just four days ago .

Sky News reports that the police are "examining claims" that Epstein was involved in trafficking women to the Balmoral estate owned by the Royal Family.

Forbes is headlining "Deutsche Bank Leak Reveals $582 Million In Suspicious Epstein Payments"

And Reuters have published a special report - "Why Epstein Loved Russia" - which they rather comically volunteer...

found no evidence Jeffrey Epstein worked for Russian intelligence, acted for the Russian government or met Vladimir Putin.

These are just in the last couple of days.

So maybe we are also going to get a fresh wave of "friend of Epstein" type hysteria - possibly aimed at bringing down one or two prominent-yet-disposable public figures.

With the Democrats just "winning" the mid-terms, the odds are it will be a Republican, or Republican-aligned figure...or maybe an Israeli . Or maybe a mixed bag of entities they want to discredit or just retire from public life.

For a little confirmation that this aspect might be in the offing, check out this Reuters piece on Robert Garcia, expected to become the next chair of the oversight committee...

Representative Robert Garcia, the likely next House oversight committee chair, sent letters on Wednesday to 12 of President Donald Trump's top allies , former aides and family members, signaling planned investigations into alleged Trump family corruption, the Jeffrey Epstein files and the administration's immigration crackdown.

Garcia is among the newly empowered Democrats who swept to power in this month's midterm elections and who plan to use that oversight ability to, as Garcia said in a statement, "put an end to this Administration's self-dealing, misconduct and abuse."

We can see the story coming together. Expect some newly released or unredacted files, some "tough questioning" in some senate committee for a Trump ally or two, and perhaps some resignations.

That's an easy PR win for the Team Blue NPCs, who will claim "the democrats brought more of the Epstein class to justice in six months than Trump has in three years", or words to that effect.

At the same time it will feed into the febrile "all men are predators" atmosphere raging across the Western world right now.

Will they actually go all-in on the murder story? Maybe, but probably not, at least not soon, because it's a good card to keep back to play in an emergency.

But then, who knows maybe they will dovetail these two threads and we'll get some big expose about a highly placed gang of perverts (including members of the royal family?) who offed Epstein in order to keep their dirty secrets from coming out.

Wherever it goes it will have very little to do with fighting real corruption - because these media circuses never do.

Now, as to who the person (or people) could be that end up being named and shamed...I genuinely don't know.

Feel free to make your own guesses...

scraped.description: ZeroHedge - On a long enough timeline, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero
scraped.author: Tyler Durden
scraped.h1: Watch: Giza Highway Turns Into A Fireball As Fuel Tanker Explodes, Killing At Least 30
scraped.body_text:
A tanker carrying petroleum products overturned and exploded on Cairo's Ring Road on Wednesday evening, killing at least 30 people and injuring 15 , according to Egypt's Health Ministry, which raised its preliminary toll from an initial 21.

The blast hit above Tunnel 10 in the Al-Warraq district of Giza, the governorate across the Nile from central Cairo that is home to the pyramids. Flames from the burning tanker spread to several vehicles caught in traffic around it , sending a column of black smoke over the highway.

لحظة انفجار الدائري.. فيديو متداول يرصد لحظة وقوع حادث الطريق الدائري بالوراق! #الوراق #إحنا_الشعب pic.twitter.com/iHRQf7kxtz

— صدى مصر (@sadamisr25) November 25, 2026

According to Egypt's Petroleum Ministry, the tanker veered off the road and crashed before it caught fire. Authorities have not yet given an official cause.

A major fire broke out on Cairo's Ring Road near Warraq after a petroleum tanker reportedly overturned and caught fire. 🚨 #lovincairo pic.twitter.com/7UORdFUxnN

— Lovin Cairo | لوڤن القاهرة (@LovinCairo) November 25, 2026

The Health Ministry said 39 ambulances joined the rescue and that the injured went to Zayed Specialized Hospital, Imbaba General Hospital and Al-Warraq Central Hospital. Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar ordered hospitals near the scene onto a higher state of readiness and sent two deputies to the site and the receiving hospitals.

Civil protection crews brought the blaze under control, state-run Al Ahram reported , while traffic police closed the affected stretch of the Ring Road and set up diversions. Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsi ordered her ministry's Giza directorate and Egyptian Red Crescent teams to get emergency aid to the victims.

President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi offered his "sincere condolences and heartfelt sympathy" to the families of the dead, his office said , and directed authorities to give the injured full medical care and to clear the wreckage from the road quickly.

The Ring Road loops around Greater Cairo and carries commuter traffic and freight between the capital, Giza and the surrounding provinces. Heavy trucks have been behind some of Egypt's deadliest crashes: last year a court sentenced a lorry driver to 15 years in prison over a crash on the Regional Ring Road in Menoufia that killed 19 people, 18 of them teenage girls.

items.summary: Someone Is Actually Making 'George Floyd: The Musical' A small New Jersey record label is developing a satirical musical about George Floyd's 2020 death, and a casting notice for the project on a job board run by Playbill drew outrage from Broadway stars before the theater publication pulled the ad, apologized and banned the company.Floyd, a black man, died in May 2020 in Minneapolis while being detained by police. scraped.title: Someone Is Actually Making 'George Floyd: The Musical'
scraped.description: ZeroHedge - On a long enough timeline, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero
scraped.author: Tyler Durden
scraped.h1: Someone Is Actually Making 'George Floyd: The Musical'
scraped.body_text:
A small New Jersey record label is developing a satirical musical about George Floyd's 2020 death, and a casting notice for the project on a job board run by Playbill drew outrage from Broadway stars before the theater publication pulled the ad, apologized and banned the company.

Floyd, a black man, died in May 2020 in Minneapolis while being detained by police. Officers had responded to a report that Floyd used a counterfeit $20 bill at a store. Video of officer Derek Chauvin kneeling on his neck during the arrest quickly went viral and set off nationwide protests and rioting . A jury later convicted Chauvin of murder and manslaughter.

Chauvin's defense argued at trial that fentanyl in Floyd's system and a heart condition contributed to his death, but that was unlikely to sway the jury in such a high-profile and politically charged case. The Hennepin County medical examiner listed fentanyl intoxication and Floyd's heart condition as factors, but still ruled the death a homicide.

Busted Broadway, the label behind the project, posted the notice on Playbill Jobs on Wednesday, Nov. 18. It sought comedic singers and rappers for a cast recording of 'George Floyd the Musical' and specifically asked for people willing to perform "offensive material". The listing describes the show as dark, edgy, and controversial and explicitly asks anyone who finds the material offensive not to apply.

Kevin Lynch is making a George Floyd dark COMEDY musical. Known 4 filiing MULTIPLE federal lawsuits alleging racial discrimination against theater organizations, he claimed he was subjected 2 reverse racism hostile work environments & unfair exclusion from opportunities due 2 DEI pic.twitter.com/j5Ye7TyTmO

— sagesurge (@sagesurge) November 19, 2026

The company has marketed the show as satire, and the show's tagline is "The $20 bill that changed the world," in reference to the fake $20 bill that led to Floyd's arrest.

Anyone can submit a listing to Playbill Jobs for $39.95, subject to approval. Playbill approved the Busted Broadway notice, removing it only after the backlash began.

" Late yesterday afternoon, Playbill Jobs incorrectly approved a job listing that had no place on our site, " Playbill said in a statement . "Once leadership was alerted, the listing was immediately removed, and we began reviewing and revising our approval processes. We apologize unequivocally for giving this hateful listing any further air, and we promise to do better going forward."

The publication said the listing "has upset and offended many" and that its appearance on the site disappointed readers who rely on Playbill . "For that, we are sorry, and are committed to regaining your trust," the statement said.

Playbill Chairman Philip Birsh and COO Alex Birsh took full responsibility for all the uproar the failure caused in the theater community, and immediately tried to make amends. To show just how serious they are, Busted Broadway is now permanently barred from Playbill Jobs, and Playbill will not cover its productions.

Both executives apologized multiple times and insisted that the speed of their response showed how seriously they take the matter.

Busted Broadway launched in 2026 and operates out of West Milford, New Jersey. The label produces satirical cast albums for shows it says are too raunchy and absurd for any stage, including "Human Centipede: The Musical" and "Genghis Khan: The Musical."

According to the company's website, the founders are a small team of musicians committed to absurd humor.

One of the artists behind the label, Kevin Lynch, sued Playwrights Horizons after saying he was excluded from its BIPOC night; the theater said the matter was settled out of court.

The company defended the Floyd project in a social media statement on Thursday. "Busted Broadway seeks to push the limits of what is possible in musical theatre by producing provocative and satirical musical cast albums," the company wrote. "Our George Floyd the Musical is not making light of, condoning, or mocking the horrific 2020 murder of George Floyd."

" It's a satire on the culture, rather than the person, " the statement continued. " Never judge a show by its title, as many who have never seen the script or score appear to be doing now."

pic.twitter.com/erlBEer85B

— Busted Broadway™ (@BustedBroadway) November 19, 2026

Actress and singer Malynda Hale posted screenshots of the notice in an Instagram video and called the project "outrageously disrespectful." "I'm usually not speechless, but this is what we're doing in 2026?" she added. Viola Davis responded to Hale's post with sheer disbelief and said she would have loved to be there when someone pitched the idea.

Actress Rachel Zegler had some rather strong words in a separate comment, describing the project as "insanely awful". Donna Murphy wrote, "Ummm... if this is a real thing- DISGUSTING & DISTURBING."

Questlove (who's done three Broadway shows) said it took him about 17 seconds to process the headline. He initially thought it was going to be a show about the namesake of a line of countertop sandwich grills before he realized what it was actually about.

Progressive activists and cultural figures adopted Floyd as a symbol of racial injustice and police violence. Floyd had an extensive criminal record, including multiple drug-related convictions and a 2009 aggravated robbery conviction, for a 2007 home invasion, that sent him to prison.

Six years on, Floyd is still treated as untouchable by pop culture - immune to criticism, let alone parody. Curiously, Busted Broadway's previous musicals about a horror film and a mass murderer drew no outrage . This time, the title alone was enough to trigger a pile-on and for Playbill to brand the project "hateful."

Busted Broadway's website still listed "George Floyd the Musical" as coming soon.

scraped.title: Inside the ADL’s Onslaught on Wikipedia to Infiltrate & Take Over the Platform
scraped.description: A new report from Tech for Palestine lays out a concerted, yearslong attack from the government of Israel and its allies to discredit, infiltrate, and take over Wikipedia. The Israel lobby understands the power and influence of the online encyclopedia and is attempting to turn it into a tool for Zionist propaganda., ADL, Alan MacLeod investigation, Foreign Affairs, International, Israel, Wikipedia,
scraped.author: Alan Macleod
scraped.h1: Inside the ADL’s Onslaught on Wikipedia to Infiltrate & Take Over the Platform
scraped.body_text:
Wikipedia is under a sustained and coordinated attack from the Israel lobby, who are attempting to undermine, discredit, infiltrate and, ultimately, take over the platform so it becomes a reliable mouthpiece for Israeli government narratives. That is the conclusion of a new 223-page report from Tech for Palestine .

The Israel lobby sees the online encyclopedia as an enormously important resource shaping the public’s understanding of the world. For that reason, pro-Israel pressure group, the Anti-Defamation League (ADL) is leading what it calls a “sustained, multi-front external pressure [campaign] on the platform.”

That operation has included attempting to discredit Wikipedia as a hotbed of support for Hamas and anti-semitism in order to prevent highly influential A.I. chatbots like ChatGPT from relying on it for its answers to users’ questions (especially on Israel/Palestine matters). It also has a team of 45 full-time analysts tracking and attempting to dox (publicly identify) Wikipedia users and editors who do not share Israel’s worldview.

At least 20 pro-Israel groups (including some from the government of Israel itself) are engaging in a covert, coordinated attempt to edit the platform to obscure evidence of Israel’s crimes in Gaza and beyond, and recast the country in a more positive light.

Meanwhile, the ADL’s allies in Washington are pressuring Wikipedia, attempting to connect it to Iran and other hostile actors, actions which could result in the Wikimedia foundation losing its charitable status.

MintPress explores the raging, silent battle to control one of the Internet’s most influential stores of knowledge.

A central pillar of the attack on Wikipedia is the Anti-Defamation League, who have published a number of reports revealing what it characterizes as a coordinated attempt to push hate and anti-Jewish bias on the platform, “shift[ing] balanced narratives toward skewed ones, spotlighting criticism of Israel and downplaying Palestinian terrorist violence and antisemitism.”

The ADL claims that it uncovered a network of at least 30 Wikipedia editors circumventing the encyclopedia’s rules to “introduce antisemitic narratives, anti-Israel bias, and misleading information.” These editors, it states, have, since October 7, 2023, worked together to change pages relating to Israel and its attack on its neighbors.

The report, however, like much of what the ADL publishes , is replete with serious methodological flaws. Firstly, they made no attempt to provide evidence showing these editors actually worked together, and were not simply individual actors whose opinions differed from the Israeli government’s line.

Dr. Shira Klein, a noted (Jewish) academic whose work the ADL’s study is partially based on, described it as “dismal”, “very skewed” and “riddled with errors.” “Where is the evidence of editors repeatedly misrepresenting or contradicting peer-reviewed literature? There is none. The report simply wants us to take the ADL’s word for it,” she said, adding that even her own research on anti-Semitism was heavily misrepresented.

Tech for Palestine was perhaps even more scathing, writing :

The ADL wants you to think it found 30 antisemites in a room, conspiring to stick it to the Jews. But the ADL have not found anything to connect these people apart from edits on Wikipedia. They don’t have the basics of a conspiracy. Who is the organizer? Where are their instructions? When or where do they meet? The ADL does not have any of this information, almost certainly because it does not exist.”

The ADL report did not even attempt to refute the editors’ work or statements as factually incorrect. Nevertheless, it recommended Wikipedia appoint a new board of “reputable experts” (i.e., pro-Israel actors) who would control the site’s Israel-Palestine related content, as well as a U.S. government-appointed “task force” dedicated to combatting anti-Semitism on Wikipedia.

In this sense, the ADL’s targeting of Wikipedia is reminiscent of the successful playbook it ran against TikTok, which eventually saw the platform sold to the family of Oracle co-founder, Larry Ellison . Ellison a close friend and disciple of Israeli prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, and the largest single private donor to the Friends of The Israeli Defense Forces.

The result, according to Issam Hijazi , has been a total seachange. “TikTok’s U.S. operations went to a consortium led by Oracle. The new owners now control the algorithm and are retraining it. And TikTok’s leadership has said that ‘Zionist’ is treated as hate speech when used as a slur or a stand-in for Jewish identity,” he told MintPress.

Hijazi is the founder of UpScrolled , a viral social media platform born out of the mass censorship and shadow banning of pro-Palestinian voices online.

“These are executive decisions. You don’t put people with those ties in charge of what counts as ‘terrorism’ or ‘hate’ and expect neutral results. The results aren’t neutral,” he added; “One side gets censored, the other gets a pass. That’s a choice, not a glitch.”

In a leaked November 2023 recording, ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt revealed his deep concern that pro-Palestine content was going viral on TikTok and that young people in particular were being exposed to raw video of Israeli military crimes via the platform.

“We have a major, major, major generational problem…all the polling I’ve seen, ADL’s polling, ICC’s polling, independent polling, suggests the issue of US support for Israel is not left and right, it is young and old…We really have a TikTok problem, a Gen Z problem,” he said .

Greenblatt and the ADL managed to form an alliance with anti-China hawks in Congress and the Senate in order to drive through TikTok’s forced sale.

Another key goal of the ADL report is to intimidate Wikipedians into silence. Greenblatt noted that he has a team of 45 employees whose primary mission is to track and identify pro-Palestine editors. Those who have been publicly identified have faced death threats.

Like with TikTok, the ADL has partnered with allies in Washington to turn up the heat on Wikipedia. Just weeks after the league’s first report was published, a team of 23 Congresspersons, led by prominent Democrat, Debbie Wasserman Schultz, pressured the Wikimedia Foundation to reveal the identities of the 30 editors, demanded it implement A.I.-based tools to enforce more pro-Israel editorial lines, and suggested that prominent individuals were secretly “acting on behalf of adversaries of the United States, including Iran, Hamas, and other antagonistic foreign entities.”

At the same time, then-Interim U.S. Attorney for Washington D.C., Ed Martin, leveraged information in the ADL report to challenge Wikimedia’s 501(c)(3) status – a designation that allows it to fundraise as a charitable organization and exempts it from Federal income tax.

Tech for Palestine note that all 23 elected officials who went after Wikipedia have been funded by AIPAC and other pro-Israel lobbying groups, totalling over $96 million as of November 2026.

The organization deems the attack so severe that they recommend that the Wikimedia Foundation relocate its operations abroad. “As tech slides into the U.S. autocratic regime, the Wikimedia Foundation is faced with a difficult situation in which its corporate structure and environment are subject to influence that goes against Wikimedia values,” they wrote, adding: “Choosing to remain in the U.S. may inevitably lead to an awful choice: capitulate to political pressure for influence over the encyclopedia, or be subject to significant penalties for non-compliance, including the loss of 501(c)(3) status.”

“As a result, we believe the Wikimedia foundation has no choice but to leave the U.S., and to choose a jurisdiction that will uphold its impartiality and values,” it concludes, suggesting the Netherlands, Belgium, or Switzerland as potentially suitable locations.

Paul Biggar, the Tech for Palestine report’s lead author, spoke with MintPress. “I don’t think it’s new for U.S. politicians to push for Israel,” he said; “Israel can cause the U.S. to start wars – of course they can cause them to try to get influence over Wikimedia.”

The ultimate goal of the onslaught against Wikipedia is to pressure it into accepting reforms that would turn it into a Zionist operation. If that cannot be reached, they seek to undermine its credibility to the point where it is not seen as a reliable source of information, especially to A.I. companies, who will drop it in favor of news articles from American corporate media, who already display a pronounced pro-Israel bias . Moreover, it seems clear that the ADL is attempting to ensure that there will be negative consequences for the 30 Wikipedia editors, making them an example of what happens if you challenge Israel and its lobby online.

Lost in this debate is the fact that, in many ways, Wikipedia is already structurally pro-Israel. This starts from the very top. Jimmy Wales, Wikipedia co-founder and chairman emeritus of the Wikimedia Foundation, is a vocal and passionate advocate of Israel. Wales visited Israel more than 10 times before 2015 alone, including one trip where he received a $1 million prize from an Israeli institution.

He has a long history of defending the country online. In 2011, he dismissed one activist’s comments about Apartheid and the killing of innocent civilians as “complaining,” and countered by condemning Hamas rocket strikes. I’m a strong supporter of Israel, so I don’t listen to…critics,” Wales told the Jewish Telegraphic Agency in 2015.

Amid the ongoing conflict, Wales has attempted to use his influence to move Wikipedia towards a more pro-Israel direction, calling one article that stated Israel was carrying out ethnic cleansing in Gaza as “particularly egregious” as this framing was, in his words, “particularly contested.”

Wikipedia has also long been hostile to alternative media in favor of the corporate press. MintPress News, as well as a host of other alternative publications, has been effectively banned from Wikipedia as a source since 2019, after a small group of pro-Israel users managed to blacklist us.

Ironically, Israel and pro-Israel forces are doing exactly what the ADL accuses Palestinian organizations of doing. The Tech for Palestine report lays out 17 separate groups that have, over the past two decades, “conspired to make Wikipedia more pro-Israel.” Nine of these groups are still active.

The Committee for Accuracy on Middle East Reporting in America (CAMERA), for example, was revealed to be manipulating the online encyclopedia as far back as 2008, undertaking a secretive and coordinated campaign to quietly recruit existing Wikipedia contributors to their cause. CAMERA played the long game, instructing their operatives to avoid sensitive political subjects (like Israel) and instead build up their credibility over the years editing other articles until they could be elected as administrators, giving them greater influence to shape the site’s outlook and suppress alternative (anti-Zionist) perspectives.

At the same time, the Yesha Council – an Israeli organization then-headed by future prime minister, Naftali Bennet – was recruiting as many Israelis as possible to infiltrate and edit Wikipedia so it displayed a more pro-Israel bias.

Bennett was completely candid about the operation, stating openly that:

The goal of the day is to teach people how to edit in Wikipedia, which is the number one source of information today in the world. As way of example, if someone searches the Gaza flotilla, we wanna be there. We wanna be the guys who influence what is written there, how it’s written, and to ensure that it’s balanced and Zionist in nature.”

Bennett’s organization arranged rewards and prizes for those who removed the most troublesome facts. The one who made the most changes was crowned “Best Zionist editor” and received a free hot air balloon ride across the country.

The government of Israel has long understood how important the battle for public opinion is. In 2026, it quintupled its hasbara (foreign public relations) budget to $730 million. Much of that cash went on gigantic advertising campaigns on platforms such as YouTube. A 2025 MintPress investigation found that, between June and July 2025 alone, the Israeli Government Advertising Agency paid for tens of millions of ads on YouTube, primarily targeting the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, and Greece. Many of these ads blatantly broke Google’s advertising rules around displaying shocking or inappropriate content.

It has also been working with big tech platforms to directly censor Palestinian voices. Hijazi noted that, according to the company’s internal data, Meta (the parent of Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp) complied with 94% of Israeli government takedown requests.

For the most part in social media, the Israeli government is pushing at an open door. Most platforms are openly pro-Israel, while a series of MintPress News investigations by this author has revealed “former” Israeli spies working in top jobs at Facebook , TikTok , Apple , Microsoft , and Google .

“They’ve stopped hiding it,” Hijazi said of Israel’s attempts to influence social media; “Last year Netanyahu sat down with pro-Israel influencers in New York and told them social media is the most important weapon Israel has. Israeli officials call it the ‘eighth front.’ In that same meeting he called the TikTok sale ‘the most important purchase going on right now.’”

“The Anti-Defamation League is the Israel Lobby. That’s their function and that’s what they do,” Biggar said; “And they’ve long run a spy operation, just now they do it online.”

What Biggar is referring to here is the near century-long history of the ADL working with the government to monitor and suppress progressive movements. As early as the 1930s, the ADL carried out surveillance operations against democratic organizations, reporting their activities to the House Committee on Un-American Activities – a government organization dedicated to stamping out left-wing thought. Although they formally opposed McCarthyism, the ADL also secretly fed information on a host of organizations to the FBI, becoming, in effect, a private spying agency.

The ADL stood against the student movement of the 1960s, attacking the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC) and branding them “racists.” But it reserved special vitriol for the Black liberation movement, spying on the NAACP and on Martin Luther King Jr. himself. It also attempted to keep the racist apartheid government in South Africa afloat, monitoring the actions and movements of African National Congress Party and top anti-apartheid activists like Archbishop Desmond Tutu, sharing that information with the white supremacist government.

More recently, the ADL has sought to undermine the Movement for Black Lives, strongly criticizing it for highlighting connections between how people of color are treated in the U.S. and how Israel treats Palestinians.

This snooping continues to the present day. In a recent talk , Greenblatt himself noted that his organization has 40 full-time analysts dedicated to monitoring “left-wing extremists…like the DSA [Democratic Socialists of America],” and is passing that information on to the FBI.

Indeed, there is barely a progressive organization, institution, or movement that the ADL has not attacked. In 1993, the San Francisco District Attorney investigated the league, and revealed that it had collected confidential information on nearly 10,000 activists and more than 700 organizations and had infiltrated countless more groups. Those targeted included the United Farm Workers, the AFL-CIO, Greenpeace and a host of progressive Arab-American and Jewish-American organizations. The ADL even spied on the AIDS Coalition to Unleash Power (ACT UP) and fought to keep homophobia out of anti-bias curricula.

Explaining this, the league’s former research director Irwin Suall categorically stated that “It’s the American left that’s the biggest threat to American Jews.” Considering the long history of anti-Semitic attacks from far-right groups such as the Ku Klux Klan, this statement could be seen as ahistorical, at best. However, if “American Jews” is a euphemism for “the Israeli state,” then perhaps Suall’s supposition makes sense.

That the ADL acts as an unofficial spying organization or a front for the Israeli government is barely in question. Throughout its history, it has passed sensitive data on to Tel Aviv. A 1969 FBI memo noted that the ADL was very likely breaking the Foreign Agents Registration Act by acting as an arm of the Israeli state. “It is felt incredible to assume [the ADL] is not furnished to an official of the Government of Israel”, the memo concluded.

Greenblatt himself has long conflated Judaism, Zionism, and Israel as one and the same. In a 2023 interview with MSNBC, he stated that anti-Zionism was not just anti-Semitism, but that “anti-Zionism is genocide.” Explaining his position, he insisted that, “Every Jewish person is a Zionist…it is fundamental to our existence.” And in a 2025 T.V. appearance , he used the phrase “our national anthem” when referring to Israel, despite the fact that he is a U.S.-born American citizen.

Since the October 7 attacks, Greenblatt and the ADL have been sounding the alarm about a supposedly historic new wave of anti-Semitism across America. One 2023 report , published at the height of Israel’s destruction of Gaza, claimed that anti-Semitic incidents in the U.S. had skyrocketed by more than 400%.

The provocative findings made headlines across the West. But hidden in the data was an unclear methodology and many highly questionable assumptions. Chief amongst these were that at least 153 rallies and demonstrations for Palestine were included as “anti-Semitic incidents” – underscoring Greenblatt’s assertion that any form of opposition to Israel’s Zionist policies is anti-Semitic. Other notable “incidents” included multiple instances of swastikas etched onto toilet cubicles and the like – hardly the sort of occurrence a reader would think of when imagining an anti-Semitic attack.

Thus, the ADL report had the effect of changing the subject, just as the world was focussing on Israel’s crimes in Gaza. And yet, for all the hyperfocussing on graffiti swastikas, the ADL has been surprisingly blasé when it comes to some of the highest profile displays of Nazism in America.

Last year, at an inauguration rally for President Trump, tech billionaire Elon Musk (whose family has deep connections to Nazism and has expressed his vocal support for fascist politicians across Europe) performed two enthusiastic “Heil Hitler” salutes on stage. Just months previously, Greenblatt had compared the Palestinian keffiyeh to the Nazi swastika. And yet, his organization rushed out a statement defending Musk from opprobrium, criticizing those who saw his “awkward hand gesture in a moment of enthusiasm” as overly anxious. Musk is a strong supporter of the State of Israel.

“The ADL is being crystal clear about where it stands,” said Beth Miller, political director at Jewish Voice for Peace. “They have made it as clear as possible that they are not a reputable source of information when it comes to anti-Semitism. They are not actually prioritising the protection of Jewish communities at all.”

Perhaps some of the ADL’s reluctance to condemn Musk stem from Greenblatt’s own controversial views on race. Earlier this month, he came out strongly against race mixing and intermarriage. Speaking with The Tel Avivian and the Rabbinic podcast, he said that he would not allow his children to marry other religions. “My children are Jews and they will create Jewish families in Jewish households. End of story. Non-negotiable,” he insisted.

To be fair to Greenblatt, this is merely mirroring the official stance of the State of Israel, where inter-racial marriages are effectively outlawed, and Jews and non-Jews are barred by law from marrying.

For an organization that presents itself as a liberal civil rights group, the Anti-Defamation League has an unusual sideline: training the police, FBI, and ICE agents. The ADL is the single largest non-governmental police trainer in the country. Every major metropolitan police department in America has sent officers to the ADL’s Advanced Training School in Washington, D.C., which has provided instruction on extremism and terrorism for more than 250 U.S. agencies. Indeed, until 2025, ADL training was mandatory for all new FBI special agents and intelligence analysts. The partnership was only brought to an end by FBI director Kash Patel after the ADL decided to classify conservative activist Charlie Kirk an extremist.

The ADL also facilitates American law enforcement officials to train in Israel, and for the forces of both countries to trade practices with each other. In that way, the surveillance and intimidation tactics honed on Palestinians find their way back to the United States, where police increasingly treat low-income neighborhoods and communities of color similarly to how Israel views its indigenous population.

One example of that was the infamous killing of Michael Brown in Ferguson, MO. In 2014, police officer Darren Wilson shot the unarmed 18-year-old black male while he had his hands up and was begging him not to fire. The event sparked nationwide protests.

Wilson’s police chief, Timothy Fitch, the head of the county police department, had received an ADL-funded trip to Israel, where he met and was trained by Israeli counterinsurgency specialists.

For all their talk about opposing anti-Semitism at home, a new poll found that 66% of American Jews actually believe that the Israel lobby’s behavior – attacking politicians and groups who oppose Israel’s actions – is increasing anti-Semitism in the United States.

Despite this, it is clear that further Israel lobby attacks are coming, including against Wikipedia. The Tech for Palestine report warns that the Heritage Foundation has also announced plans to unmask Wikipedia editors as part of its Project Esther – a plan it claims is aimed at dismantling a U.S.-wide Hamas support network. The Foundation for Defense of Democracies is working with an Israel-based “Wikipedia intelligence” company to stalk the encyclopedia’s editors.

And members of Congress and the Senate continue to pile more pressure on the site to kowtow to its demands, just as TikTok eventually did.

If American Jews are correct, all this will only make their lives more difficult by increasing the levels of anti-Jewish sentiment. But for the ADL and other organizations that collectively make up lobby, that is of minor importance. Their number one goal has always been playing defense for Israel.
scraped.lead_paragraph: Wikipedia is under a sustained and coordinated attack from the Israel lobby, who are attempting to undermine, discredit, infiltrate and, ultimately, take over the platform so it becomes a reliable mouthpiece for Israeli government narratives. That is the conclusion of a new 223-page report from Tech for Palestine .

scraped.author: https://www.thegatewaypundit.com/author/cristina/
scraped.h1: JUST IN: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed Due to Weather
scraped.body_text:
Macy’s postponed its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday due to weather.

This is the first time that the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has ever been postponed.

The Macy’s Day Parade has only been canceled three times during World War II.

According to the National Weather Service , a strong coastal storm is bringing heavy rain, strong winds to New York City on Thanksgiving Day.

NBC News reported :

Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be pushed back to Saturday because of severe weather, officials said.

“The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our City and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year’s celebration,” Macy’s said Wednesday.

The parade will now happen at 8:30 a.m. ET Saturday.

“Thank you to the thousands of volunteers, performers and partners who create the magic millions enjoy each year. We look forward to celebrating together on Saturday,” Macy’s said.

The cancellation comes as the East Coast is forecast to be hit by a strong storm bringing heavy rain, strong winds and coastal flooding on Thanksgiving Day, according to the National Weather Service.

BREAKING: Macy’s postpones its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday, Nov. 28, as severe weather threatens New York City .

Organizers cite the safety of participants and spectators as their top priority as they work to finalize plans for the rescheduled celebration.

This marks the first time Macy’s has postponed the parade due to weather.

The historic event has only been canceled three times before, all during World War II, when rubber and helium were needed for the military.

scraped.body_text:
Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers have arrested another group of criminal illegal immigrants with convictions for sexually abusing a young child, rape and large-scale cocaine trafficking, according to the Department of Homeland Security.

The department called the men part of the “worst of the worst” and said all five were taken into custody in a single day. DHS credits President Trump’s America First mandate, saying mass deportations are lowering costs and saving American lives. The agency lists public safety threats ICE arrests across the country on its DHS.Gov webpage.

“While Americans are making last-minute preparations for Thanksgiving, the brave men and women of ICE are working around the clock to arrest and remove illegal aliens from our communities. Just yesterday, ICE arrested pedophiles, rapists, drug dealers, and other public safety threats,” said Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin. “Despite endless smears from sanctuary politicians, our ICE officers continue to do their job and protect the American people from criminals like these.”

Among those arrested:

The cases reach from Long Island to Southern California, with arrests tied to convictions in Virginia, Florida and Missouri along the way. Two of the men were convicted of sex crimes, one of them against a child under 13. Another was convicted in federal court of taking part in a conspiracy involving at least five kilograms of cocaine.

The arrests are part of the Trump administration’s ongoing campaign to find, detain and deport illegal immigrants, with priority placed on those already convicted of crimes inside the United States. Mullin also pushed back on sanctuary politicians who have criticized the agency, saying ICE officers will keep doing their jobs. DHS invites Americans who want to see more of the criminal illegal aliens arrested in their own communities to visit the agency’s public listing.

scraped.description: Nearly 41 percent of staff at the Minneapolis Emergency Communications Center (911) have used Minnesota’s Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) program…
scraped.h1: Over 40 percent of Minneapolis 911 Call Center Staff on Paid Family, Medical Leave
scraped.body_text:
Nearly 41 percent of staff at the Minneapolis Emergency Communications Center (911) have used Minnesota’s Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) program, driving up overtime costs and straining staffing levels.

The Daily Wire reports the Minneapolis Emergency Communications Center (MECC) saw its budget surge $1.5 million annually — from $15 million to $16.5 million, a 10 percent increase.

Critics are blaming Minnesota’s Paid Family and Medical Leave Act, which Democrats in the Legislature passed in 2023 and took effect for all employers this year.

That policy allows individual workers to take up to 12 weeks of paid leave annually and also allows up to 12 weeks of medical leave annually, or a total of 20 weeks if they are taken together, according to The Daily Wire.

The Minneapolis Star Tribune reports Leticia Cardenas, assistant director for Minneapolis Emergency Communications Center, revealed during a recent budget meeting that 41 percent of her staff members were out on paid leave.

That revelation prompted some pointed questions from Council Member Linea Palmisano who went on the record to ask:

“That feels like a lot. And I’m curious, I’m not sure how it would work in 911 versus some of our other roles — Can people immediately take the paid leave when they come on as an employee? And then upon their return from that paid leave, can they quit? Can they quit the job?!”

Cardenas replied, “Yes to both of those,” confirming that new employees could simply take paid leave from the day that they were hired and then quit the job once that leave expired — meaning they could take up to 20 weeks of paid leave funded through the state’s PFML premiums, part of which the city pays.

“PFML has created a new challenge for us because it doesn’t have the parameters around it fully built in yet and so, as we navigate that, we’re learning new rules and new ways people are able to utilize it,” Cardenas explained.

For the 911 Department, that sometimes means other workers have to work overtime to meet minimum staffing requirements, according to the Star Tribune.

Better Minneapolis reports that other departments, such as the 311 center (roughly 17 percent of its 23 staff), have also seen absences, though many other divisions can shift tasks among salaried staff.

Critics are questioning higher overtime expenses and taxpayer strain, while supporters argue paid leave helps reduce burnout and turnover in high-stress roles like emergency dispatch.

41% of city employees in Minneapolis are on Paid Minnesota Family Leave!

That’s insane. Minnesota residents are footing the bill for this.

scraped.h1: Jason Whitlock: Stephen A. Smith is being used by Disney to fuel racial division
scraped.body_text:
Whitlock says ESPN's star commentator is being paid to turn the Lakers' white players into a racially divisive sports debate.

Stephen A. Smith just can't seem to stop taking shots at the Los Angeles Lakers' white players. But BlazeTV host Jason Whitlock says there's a reason ESPN's biggest personality keeps stoking racial tensions — and it has everything to do with money.

After Smith tripled down on his criticism of Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, and Walker Kessler because they're white, Whitlock accuses the ESPN commentator of doing Disney's bidding, arguing that the company benefits from a sports conversation increasingly defined by racial division.

“Stephen A. Smith continues to triple down, not double down, triple down on his racially divisive discussion of the Los Angeles Lakers. Why he’s doing this, I think, is obvious. He’s being paid to do it,” Whitlock says.

- YouTube

“He’s doing it in the most primitive and Neanderthal way because that’s all he’s capable of, and because quite honestly, it works here in America,” he continues, before playing a clip of Smith “tripling down” on his initial comments.

“They’re acting like this is a conversation that we don’t have,” Smith said. “They’re acting like if three white dudes rolled up in a park together at any hood, or any urban community in the United States … that as brothers … we wouldn’t sit up there and look at it with a raised eyebrow and be like, ‘I know they don’t think they coming up here to take our spot.’”

“It’s as simple as that. And that’s what’s bothering me about the kind of attitude that everybody is showing towards this subject. You’re acting like I’m making something up and I’m not,” he added.

Whitlock says Smith is “ghetto-fying” the “conversation about the Lakers.”

“He’s bragging about it because, ‘Hey, this is what we did in the park. This is what we do on street corners. This is what we do at the barbershop.’ This is what a group of idiots do,” he says.

Whitlock says his criticism of Smith goes beyond their disagreement over the Lakers. While people have asked him why he’s so “hypercritical” of Smith, he says it’s because “you have to have unqualified, compromised people at the very top of these industries.”

“People that you could control, that you could put puppet strings on. They’re unqualified, they don’t have the intellectual capacity to elevate a conversation. And so all they can do is devalue and lower a conversation and follow the instructions,” he explains.

“And if Disney wants to promote racial division, you have to take a compromised, unqualified person, convince them, and install them at the top of the conversation of some industry, put a battery in their back, and then just let nature take its course,” he continues.

“This is the definition of a useful idiot,” he adds.

To enjoy more fearless conversations at the crossroads of culture, faith, sports, and comedy with Jason Whitlock, subscribe to BlazeTV — the largest multi-platform network of voices who love America, defend the Constitution, and live the American dream.

BlazeTV Staff

scraped.author: https://www.facebook.com/140738092630206
scraped.h1: 'Lynching': College protests reignite racial animus after black teen's tragic death
scraped.body_text:
Some have spewed 'hateful rhetoric and vile speculation' about the death of Nolan Wells, DA said.

Race radicals once again prove unwilling to let a tragedy go to waste.

Nolan Wells, a black 18-year-old student at Southwest Mississippi Community College, went missing during a Fourth of July boating trip to Horn Island, off the coast of Mississippi. His body turned up two days later, and the state medical examiner later classified the cause and manner of his death as "undetermined."

'There is not a shred of evidence to support these narratives.'

Despite no evidence of foul play, black identitarians continue to suggest that Wells' death was the result of racism.

Race hustlers rushed to insinuate wrongdoing on the part of three of Wells' white friends.

Al Sharpton, for instance, said, "I don't know what happened. But I got your history of Mississippi. And the history tells me: Black boy goes out with three white kids. Three white kids come back. There's a blurred story on what happened," reported CNN.

NFL Hall of Famer Terrell Owens called for arresting the white friends. "ARREST THEM IMMEDIATELY!! LIKE YESTERDAY!!" he posted on September 26.

The friends then sued Owens for defamation, reported ESPN. Attorneys for the three friends have alleged that both Sharpton's and Owens' remarks were defamatory.

RELATED: Minority-white British city bans flags after patriots raise the English colors

District Attorney Angel Myers McIlrath condemned such "hateful rhetoric and vile speculation," stating, "What I cannot accept, what I cannot ignore, is that false narratives that Nolan's death was somehow racially motivated and that this is a case of another young black man denied justice by a racist, corrupt system were perpetuated and allowed to spread. There is not a shred of evidence to support these narratives."

After a thorough investigation into the matter, a mixed-race grand jury — which heard from 43 witnesses and weighed evidence, including GPS data and forensic reports — found "no credible evidence to support the public allegations that any persons who rode to or from Horn Island on July 4, 2026, on the Triton, the Palm Beach, or the Tideline [boats] engaged in any criminal conduct related to the death of Mr. Wells."

The grand jury also determined that the public attacks on Wells' white friends and others "are malicious, false, and have no truth in fact or evidence."

Wells' family rejected the grand jury's determination — as did a black student group last week at the University of California, Los Angeles.

The UCLA Afrikan Student Union held a walk-out demonstration on Nov. 17, demanding "justice" for Wells. At least one protester's sign characterized Wells' death as a "lynching," reported the Daily Bruin.

A portion of the "lynching" sign can be seen at the 1:19 mark of the video below.

Footage of the protest shows David Turner III, a UCLA assistant professor of "black life and racial justice," state, "It is a history and legacy of anti-black violence that continues to happen. That is the reason why we have to be out here with signs in the first place, right?"

Black Lives Matter activist Thandiwe Abdullah was also among those to exploit Wells' death and air racial grievances at the protest. She said in a speech, "We are so dehumanized, so dehumanized that the murder of our people, of literal children and babies, seems like a fair tradeoff to a lot of people in this world," according to the Daily Bruin.

On Wednesday, students at Temple University similarly racialized Wells' death, holding signs that read, "No More Jim Crow 2.0," and "Black boys deserve to grow up," reported Temple News.

At the protest, Affiah Sangare, a journalism major, suggested that a black stereotype was used to give cover for foul play.

"They were able to act like a Black boy only drowned," said Sangare, according to Temple News. "They were trying to use the stereotypes of Black people not being able to swim and got away with it in a predominantly white community."

Like Blaze News? Bypass the censors, sign up for our newsletters, and get stories like this direct to your inbox. Sign up here !

Joseph MacKinnon

scraped.title: Trump favors fossil fuels. Solar is booming on his watch. | Blaze Media
scraped.description: Solar panels aren’t partisan. Neither are the power bills Americans pay. Gregory J. Slavonic says lawmakers should stop making the grid another proxy war over the president.
scraped.author: https://www.facebook.com/140738092630206
scraped.h1: Trump favors fossil fuels. Solar is booming on his watch.
scraped.body_text:
Solar panels aren’t partisan. Neither are the power bills Americans pay. Gregory J. Slavonic says lawmakers should stop making the grid another proxy war over the president.

Democrats have spent years insisting that Donald Trump is Public Enemy No. 1 for solar energy. To hear them tell it, his return to the White House should have been a death sentence for America's solar industry. Yet the industry’s project pipeline tells a different story.

Solar is booming under this administration. According to the U.S. Energy Information Administration , solar accounts for 51% of new utility-scale generating capacity planned for 2026. Developers expect to add 43.4 gigawatts this year, 60% more than in 2025 if those projects come online as scheduled. That growth arrives when America urgently needs more electricity.

Our military, defense contractors, and technology industries need reliable and affordable electricity.

Technology companies are building enormous data centers. Manufacturers are seeking more power, utilities face pressure to keep up, and households wonder what surging demand will mean for their bills. Every source of affordable, dependable electricity deserves serious consideration.

Solar’s expansion did not begin with Trump’s second term. Major energy projects take years to plan and build. But the administration has taken steps that can help the next round of projects.

In February, the Interior Department resumed reviews of six utility-scale solar proposals, including Nevada's Esmeralda Energy Center. In April, the White House announced a program to modernize federal permitting. In June, it promoted changes to federal environmental reviews intended to speed infrastructure construction.

Trump’s preference for traditional energy sources is hardly a secret. Nor do those actions erase his administration's fights over wind projects and clean-energy funding. Still, solar developers benefit when Washington makes it easier to secure permits and connect new power to the grid. That should be common ground.

Instead, four Democratic senators —Tammy Duckworth (D-Ill.), Ron Wyden (D-Ore.), Ed Markey (D-Mass.), and Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) — challenged the administration over canceled clean-energy grants. Before the Senate voted on a bipartisan permitting overhaul, they demanded that the grants be restored . The funding dispute may be real, but it should not obscure the bill’s potential benefits for solar projects.

That debate has now moved beyond threats to delay a vote. On November 19, the Senate passed the permitting bill, 62-33 . All four senators voted no. The legislation, which one report called the “most important energy bill in a long time,” now heads to the House, where its prospects will test whether Washington is serious about building more generating capacity.

As someone who served in senior leadership at the Pentagon during Trump’s first administration, I know how closely our national security is tied to energy infrastructure. Our military, defense contractors, and technology industries need reliable and affordable electricity. China is not waiting for us to settle every partisan quarrel before investing in the power its industries require.

RELATED: Your power bill could pay the price for America’s outdated energy politics

mammuth/iStock/Getty Images

Former Biden Energy Secretary Jennifer Granholm recognized the stakes. In October, she urged Democrats to support the permitting compromise , despite its imperfections, while warning Trump that restrictions on wind energy could jeopardize an agreement. She understood that refusing a workable deal in search of a perfect one might leave the country with neither.

Democrats who claim to champion solar should be eager to clear unnecessary obstacles to building it. They can challenge the administration's grant cancellations and still acknowledge that faster, more predictable permitting would benefit clean-energy projects. Those aims are not incompatible.

America cannot afford to turn every power plant and transmission line into a partisan loyalty test. The public needs more electricity at prices it can pay. If Democrats are serious about America's clean-energy future, they should start putting their anti-Trump obsession aside and help build it.

Gregory J. Slavonic

items.title: A Great Reversal: Washington and Caracas sign new military agreement
items.summary: The military cooperation agreement signed between the US and Venezuela formalizes the new stage of relations between the two countries.

scraped.title: A Great Reversal: Washington and Caracas sign new military agreement
scraped.description: Article originally posted on Breakthrough News The military cooperation agreement signed between the US and Venezuela formalizes the new stage of rela
scraped.author: Deja Gaston
scraped.h1: A Great Reversal: Washington and Caracas sign new military agreement
scraped.body_text:
Article originally posted on Breakthrough News

The military cooperation agreement signed between the US and Venezuela formalizes the new stage of relations between the two countries, one marked by subordination under duress. On November 18, 2026, acting President of Venezuela, Delcy Rodriguez, presided over the signing by US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Venezuelan Minister of Defense Gustavo González López of a military cooperation agreement in Caracas.

Speaking from the US Embassy in Caracas, Hegseth arrogantly stated that Venezuela “has gone from our most aggressive regional threat to a compliant security partner.”

Rubbing salt in the wound, Hegseth boasted that his trip was only “made possible” by the January 3rd operation that kidnapped President Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores, and left 32 Cubans and over 100 Venezuelans dead.

This he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America,” which “solved a 27-year problem for this hemisphere in a matter of hours.”

He recounted that “exactly one year ago today” Maduro “stood on a stage not too far from here and yelled mockingly, ‘Come and get me!’” Hegseth added, “Well, we answered that call,” calling Maduro and Flores “narco-terrorists.”

The accord, announced during an unannounced visit, provides for the resumption of technical and military cooperation, including joint training, intelligence sharing, and access to new equipment and technologies for Venezuela’s armed forces. For Washington, it marks the return of a military relationship that had been interrupted for twenty-one years by the Bolivarian Revolution. For Venezuela, it represents a definitive close to the “anti-imperialist phase” articulated by Hugo Chávez in 2004-2005, and a de facto alignment with Trump’s project to renew total US control over Latin America and the Caribbean. All countries of the region now have military agreements with Washington, with the exception of Cuba and Nicaragua.

The significance of the signing cannot be understood without the historical record that preceded it.

US military cooperation with Venezuela has never been a neutral technical exchange. US military training shaped the officer corps that carried out state repression against Venezuela’s left for decades. During the 1950s, Washington backed the dictatorship of Marcos Pérez Jiménez, whose government was notorious for its brutality and whose security forces were trained and equipped by the United States. Later, the US Army’s School of the Americas trained thousands of Latin American officers, including Venezuelans, in counterinsurgency tactics, including interrogation, torture, and summary execution, and since the 1960s, the successive governments of the corrupt 4th Republic had been deploying those methods against the Communist Party and other left organizations, with the national police agency DIGEPOL responsible for extensive human rights abuses.

That same institutional lineage was on display in the February 1989 Caracazo, a mass popular uprising against IMF austerity measures, when the US-trained military was ordered to restore order, and hundreds of civilians were killed; as Chávez, himself a military officer, later said, the massacre “created consciousness among many military personnel, especially the younger ones,” and the officers who witnessed and carried out the repression were products of a system long tutored by the United States. The Caracazo became the breaking point that convinced Chávez and his co-conspirators in the MBR-200 movement that they “could not continue to defend a murderous regime,” setting in motion the February 4, 1992 rebellion.

Declassified Pentagon training manuals endorsed torture, extortion, and execution, and several Venezuelan generals who later participated in the 2002 coup against Chávez were graduates of the School of the Americas. This was not an aberration but a consistent feature of a security relationship designed to align Latin American militaries with Washington’s Cold War in a counterinsurgency strategy in which close to 200,000 people are estimated to have been forcibly disappeared for their left-wing political activism.

The most personal and politically charged example of this history is the 1976 torture and murder of Jorge Antonio Rodríguez, father of Delcy Rodríguez. Rodríguez, a socialist activist and leader of the Socialist League, was detained by Venezuela’s DISIP intelligence service and died in custody after what his family and numerous accounts describe as torture. As Craig Murray noted in Consortium News, the killing occurred at the hands of “the CIA-backed security services of the US-aligned [Carlos Andrés] Pérez regime”. That his daughter, now the acting president, would preside over such a military accord is a measure of the transformation imposed by the US on Venezuela’s political leadership since January 3rd.

In April 2005, on his program Aló Presidente, Chávez announced the indefinite suspension of all military exchanges with the United States. He stated that US military advisers stationed in Venezuelan bases had been “waging a campaign” among the Venezuelan military against his government and the Bolivarian Revolution. “All exchanges with US officers are suspended until who knows when,” he said. “There will be no more combined operations, nothing like that”. Chávez’s decision was a direct response to growing US hostility to the Bolivarian Revolution. In addition to the 2002 coup attempt against him, which senior US officials were closely linked to, US agencies provided continued funding of opposition groups, and cover for intelligence operations against the government. The suspension was an assertion of sovereignty, a refusal to allow a foreign power to maintain a military presence inside the country, while seeking to overthrow and undermine the constitutional order.

The expulsion of the US forces was a turning point in the radicalization of the Bolivarian Revolution, and set the stage for the transformation of the state apparatus. After the 2005 suspension of US military exchanges, Venezuela moved decisively to remake its armed forces as a sovereign institution. They purged the officer corps of those tied to the old US-aligned command structure and promoted a new military doctrine to erase the legacy of decades of US military instruction. This transformation tied the military directly to the Bolivarian project.

Chávez described the armed forces as being “at the very heart of the revolution,” and the institution was reconceived as a guarantor of the people’s democratic gains and national sovereignty rather than an instrument of external powers. The concept of unión cívico-militar , or the union of the masses and the military, first proposed by Chávez in 1999, became the military’s official doctrine. In a region with a long history of right-wing coups, all other progressive presidents elected in the “pink tide” were constantly looking over their shoulders, worried that their high command remained loyal to their oligarchies. Not so in Venezuela. Having broken the Venezuelan military away from the Pentagon and trained new layers of officers and soldiers in anti-imperialism, the Bolivarian state put down continued coup plots and did not snap under the highest-pressure scenarios.

For two decades, Venezuela refused to accept the presence of US military personnel and instead built security relationships with Russia, China, and other partners. But the US never abandoned its objective of regime change. Economic sanctions, diplomatic isolation, and covert action intensified. The decisive action came on January 3, 2026, when US forces conducted a military raid in Caracas, captured President Nicolás Maduro, and transported him to New York. Delcy Rodríguez, previously vice president, was sworn in as acting president. From that moment, Venezuela’s cooperation with the United States began not as a negotiated partnership between sovereign states, but as a relationship shaped by the reality of military threats and political coercion.

The November 18 agreement formalizes that relationship. Hegseth described it as a “renewal of our defense partnership” and praised Rodríguez for “close cooperation” that allowed officials “to stabilize Venezuela and rid it of narco-terrorists”. The language is telling.

The agreement’s provisions, training, intelligence sharing, equipment, and technology are precisely the mechanisms through which the United States integrates a subordinate military into its own command and intelligence architecture. There is no suggestion that Venezuela will receive reciprocal access to US decision-making, or that the relationship will be governed by any principle other than Washington’s strategic agenda for total domination in the region.

The agreement must be situated within the broader US strategy that has come to be called the “Donroe Doctrine.” The term, a modification of the Monroe Doctrine, describes a renewed US claim to unilateral control over the Western Hemisphere. The doctrine aims to intervene directly in regional affairs, reinforce US military presence in Latin America and the Caribbean, and plunder resources to cut off China from natural resources, critical minerals, and supply chains. The January 2026 operation against Maduro was its first open application. The “Shield of the Americas,” launched in March 2026 , is its institutional vehicle: a US-led multinational security and political alliance ostensibly formed to combat drug cartels, but which in practice commits member states to “the use of lethal military force” and to limiting “foreign geopolitical interference” in the hemisphere. The coalition’s motto, as announced by Hegseth, is “We do bad things to bad people.” Such language is the naked arrogance of US imperialism.

Venezuela’s signature on November 18 is therefore not merely a bilateral military agreement. The agreement commits Venezuela’s armed forces to interoperability with the US military, to intelligence sharing that will inevitably flow toward Washington’s regional command structures, and to a training relationship that will shape the doctrine and loyalties of a new generation of Venezuelan officers. In exchange, Venezuela receives equipment and technology.

It is normal for even the most revolutionary governments to seek normal, diplomatic and peaceful relations with the great capitalist powers. Existing in a system of states, they may even have mutually beneficial areas of cooperation, while remaining ideological and political adversaries. But that is not the context for this agreement. A government whose president was kidnapped after a foreign military operation, facing continued economic sanctions and the implicit threat of further intervention, cannot be said to have negotiated as a sovereign equal. The history of US military cooperation in Venezuela, from Pérez Jiménez to the School of the Americas to the 2002 coup, demonstrates that Washington’s security relationships in the region have only one purpose: control. There is no military threat posed to the U.S. from any country in Latin America – “mutual defense” in this context is an absurdity and a smokescreen. The November 18 agreement revives the long history of domination and compliance under a new name.

It marks a major turn in US-Venezuelan relations, but not toward equality or reconciliation. It formalizes a relationship of subordination, concluded under duress.

In that sense, Hegseth did tell the truth about one thing, how he began his remarks: “Just one year ago, my presence here would have been deemed impossible, almost unimaginable.”
